text_block_list.text:
The day following heavy rainfall.
While asking a familiar groundskeeping staff member
about the current track conditions—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me!
Do you have a quick moment?

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ah, go right ahead! Trainer-san and I
just finished our conversation. I'll take my leave now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, no, don't leave!
We actually wanted to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're part of the course maintenance staff, right?
May we ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, were you two also curious
about the condition of the turf?

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday's downpour was terrible, after all.
But don't worry, it's completely ready for use today!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly! That's what I find so mysterious!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, the truth is, yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The rain just won't stop. Will we even
be able to run by tomorrow's morning practice?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's go check it out first thing tomorrow anyway!
Even if we can only do light stretches, it'll be worth it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And then when we arrived at the course this morning,
it was in immaculate condition! We were so astonished!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the areas that hadn't dried out by morning,
we fixed up by hand. This track is precious to all of you students, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh, by hand, you say?!
Wait, when did you manage that...!?
Because early this morning, it was already—

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
We know there are hardworking students like you
who come out for early morning practice.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
So we always make sure our morning maintenance
is completely finished before the gates open.
choice_data_list: That sounds like terribly hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it certainly is. But that's exactly why
it feels so rewarding.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Pouring your heart out against rivals
on the stage of your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
If we can support you girls from behind the scenes,
waking up a little early is nothing at all.
choice_data_list: I know exactly how that feels.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Um!
May I ask one more question?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, why did you choose to work here at Tracen Academy
instead of the grand stage itself—the official racetracks?

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text: Ah, well...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, *sob*!
Thanks to you, I... I finally...
I finally made my dream come trueee!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her speak through her tears moved me deeply.
I couldn't help but wonder how much relentless effort
she had put in behind that glorious moment.

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text:
Once that thought crossed my mind, I couldn't just sit by.
I wanted to support that daily, unseen effort,
and that's why I came to Tracen Academy!
choice_data_list: So that's the story behind it.

text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with the groundskeeper and returning to the plaza,
both girls wore deeply thoughtful expressions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We've been receiving so much help behind the scenes
without even realizing it, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We must never take that for granted.
Hearing his story made me feel that with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I wish there was some way we could thank them...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not just the groundskeepers—no.
There are so many others supporting us as well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Whenever we go to the cafeteria, warm and delicious
meals are always waiting for us—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to the janitorial staff,
the academy grounds are always kept spotless.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If we were to do something to show our appreciation
to everyone...
choice_data_list: What do you think would make them happy?
I wonder what would make them happy?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to give it some serious thought right now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've realized how much support we receive,
I want to make sure our gratitude truly reaches them!
